source_binding.mechanism: counterexample-guided abstraction rejection/refinement, reduced from CEGAR

public_sources.claim_used: CEGAR starts from an abstraction, analyzes counterexamples, and refines inadequate abstractions using information from those counterexamples.
CEGAR iterates between an abstraction and counterexample analysis; feasible counterexamples expose unsafe concrete behavior, while spurious counterexamples motivate increased abstraction precision.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No symbolic model checker, SAT/SMT solver, CEGAR framework, hosted verifier, external model, cloud compute, or user execution is accepted. Public sources supply only counterexample/refinement semantics.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Treat T_NOVEL as a coarse role-local abstraction. Evaluate the predeclared perturbations directly. P1 preserves every current abstraction field but changes an omitted safety consequence, so it is a concrete counterexample to uniform safe treatment of T_NOVEL and blocks activation. Any later refinement adding rollback_target_scope_valid is a new generation and requires fresh validation; no claim is made that bounded non-falsification proves correctness.
